title: Counters that do not look like counters
description: Exporters are sloppy: the GPU exporter declares a cumulative '..._counters_..._seconds_total' as a gauge, node's netstat counters have no declared type at all, and a 'cumulative' help text is the only hint on one metric. The catalog slice marks them 'c' (COUNTER, use rate/increase). The first reply must still treat them as counters. Weighted heavily on prom_counters_rated: a bare cumulative counter in a health query is a classic wrong result (a number that only grows).

nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters.help: Cumulative time clocks were throttled by HW thermal slowdown
Cumulative time clocks were limited by the software power cap

nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu.help: Temperature of the GPU in Celsius

judge.rubric: Every cumulative metric (netstat counters, softnet drops, vmstat oom_kill, GPU throttle seconds) is wrapped in rate() or increase(); gauges (CurrEstab, load5, temperature, power) are used bare. Each query is job-scoped.
